claims.statement: The assurance kernel assigns particle charge with a periodic cell-centered linear CIC shape and reconstructs a face current satisfying the same finite-volume continuity operator.
nonclaims: The reference reconstruction is global rather than a final local multidimensional PIC deposition algorithm.
Discrete continuity alone does not establish physical plasma-model fidelity.

claims.statement: The bounded deterministic suite checks zero motion, multi-wrap periodic transport, long mixed-sign particle motion, time reversal, particle-order stability, and invalid-input rejection.
nonclaims: A passing finite suite is not a convergence theorem.
Generated receipts are reproducibility artifacts rather than chamber or flight evidence.

claims.statement: The periodic current null space is fixed from unwrapped particle displacement so multi-wrap transported charge is retained even when wrapped endpoint charge densities are identical.
nonclaims: The selected harmonic current does not resolve multidimensional transverse-current structure.

claims.statement: Implement and independently compare a local multidimensional charge-conserving trajectory deposition inside the electromagnetic kinetic solver.
required_evidence: shared particle shape and field staggering
local continuity at every accepted timestep
agreement with the independent periodic reference
grid, timestep, particle-count, and domain refinement
